versions.changelog:
Initial release: Provides a comprehensive, best-practice workflow for creating highly optimized, production-grade LLM skills based on documentation websites.

- Details an 8-step end-to-end process: from site exploration and configuration to packaging and quality checks.
- Covers advanced handling of Single Page Applications (SPA), including fallback to source markdown from GitHub if scraping fails.
- Defines strict principles for documentation splitting, SKILL.md slimming, directory flattening, and llms.txt generation.
- Includes pattern library for common cases (SPA downgrade, large doc splitting, UI library security, and more).
- Adds a quality checklist and tools guide to ensure consistent, high-quality skill output.
